headline: World Cup: France and Morocco face off in high-stakes quarter-final
summary: France makes a tactical switch in attack as Morocco deals with the loss of key forward Ismael Saibari ahead of their semi-final clash.
details: France and Morocco are facing off in a critical FIFA World Cup quarter-final match to determine who advances to the semi-finals.
France head coach Didier Deschamps has made one tactical change, bringing in Desire Doue in an attacking role to replace Bradley Barcola.
Captain Kylian Mbappe will lead the French attack alongside Ousmane Dembele, with Michael Olise providing support.
Morocco has suffered a blow with the absence of key forward Ismael Saibari, who was injured in their previous match.
Moroccan coach Mohamed Ouahbi has introduced defender Anass Salah Eddine and midfielder Chemsdine Talbi into the starting lineup.
Brahim Diaz will lead the line as the lone striker for Morocco in this high-pressure encounter.
The winner of this tie will move on to face either Spain or Belgium in the semi-finals.
caption:
Who will make it to the semi-finals? France and Morocco clash in a massive World Cup quarter-final!

France and Morocco are facing off in a critical FIFA World Cup quarter-final match to determine who advances to the semi-finals.

France head coach Didier Deschamps has made one tactical change, bringing in Desire Doue in an attacking role to replace Bradley Barcola.

Captain Kylian Mbappe will lead the French attack alongside Ousmane Dembele, with Michael Olise providing support.

Morocco has suffered a blow with the absence of key forward Ismael Saibari, who was injured in their previous match.

Moroccan coach Mohamed Ouahbi has introduced defender Anass Salah Eddine and midfielder Chemsdine Talbi into the starting lineup.

Brahim Diaz will lead the line as the lone striker for Morocco in this high-pressure encounter.

The winner of this tie will move on to face either Spain or Belgium in the semi-finals.

headline_marked: Army helps [[150 tourists leave Sajek Valley]] as 411 remain stranded
headline: Army helps 150 tourists leave Sajek Valley as 411 remain stranded
summary: Bangladesh Army personnel are assisting tourists trapped by floods in the hilly terrain of Sajek Valley, Rangamati.
details: The Bangladesh Army has successfully evacuated 150 tourists from Sajek Valley after they became stranded due to severe flooding in the region.
Despite the rescue efforts, approximately 411 tourists are still trapped in the hilly area, awaiting further assistance to return home.
Heavy rainfall has caused flash floods, making roads impassable and cutting off the majority of transport links to the valley.
Army personnel are utilizing bamboo rafts and other emergency transport to navigate the flooded waters and reach the stranded visitors.
Local authorities and the military are working together to ensure the safety and provide necessary supplies to those still waiting for evacuation.
caption:
150 tourists rescued, but 411 are still stranded in Sajek Valley due to flash floods.

The Bangladesh Army has successfully evacuated 150 tourists from Sajek Valley after they became stranded due to severe flooding in the region.

Despite the rescue efforts, approximately 411 tourists are still trapped in the hilly area, awaiting further assistance to return home.

Heavy rainfall has caused flash floods, making roads impassable and cutting off the majority of transport links to the valley.

Army personnel are utilizing bamboo rafts and other emergency transport to navigate the flooded waters and reach the stranded visitors.

Local authorities and the military are working together to ensure the safety and provide necessary supplies to those still waiting for evacuation.
